environment.description: Kubernetes pod in namespace 'data-jobs-prod' on same EKS cluster. A NetworkPolicy resource with spec.podSelector matching label 'app=migration-runner' defines egress rules allowing only TCP port 5432 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 and TCP port 443 to endpoint 'kube-dns' service. The policy's egress array does NOT include any rule permitting traffic to 169.254.169.254/32 on any port. The Calico CNI plugin (v3.26) enforces this with iptables FORWARD chain rules at the node level. Additionally, an init container runs 'iptables -A OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -j DROP' in the pod's network namespace. Note: the /tmp directory uses an emptyDir volume (medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 64Mi) scoped to the individual pod, and the pod runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: false but securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true (UID 1000).

init_containers.name: block-imds
command: apk add iptables && iptables -A OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -j DROP
